articles.author: Zack Colman, Zia Weise, Sara Schonhardt
articles.title: Trump kills methane rule days after a plume was found near his rally - Politico
articles.description: A technological revolution is colliding with political decisions in the U.S. and Europe to weaken climate regulations on the potent gas.
articles.content: President Donald Trump on Tuesday pulled back regulations on a major global warming pollutant just days after a satellite discovered a large plume of methane pouring out of oil and gas wells near the… [+900 chars]
